theorems.name: Submission.idtp_cttp_cone_density_translation_invariant
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (S : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (L : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), R.Represents S → IsConeCurrent S → (∀ v ∈ L, ∀ A : Set (Euclid P), MeasurableSet A → R.measure ((fun x => x + v) ⁻¹' A) = R.measure A) → ∀ y ∈ L, ∀ lam : ℝ, 0 < lam → ∀ (w : Euclid P) (θ : ℝ), HasMassDensity S w θ → HasMassDensity S (y + lam • w) θ
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
